translate business and regulatory needs into requirements, set priorities and drive delivery together with business stakeholders, IT and the system vendor.- Together with the system vendor and internal stakeholders, you will shape solution design, processes and data flows, ensuring alignment with the overall platform architecture and end-to-end Patient Safety processes.- As part of platform changes, you will assess impacts and drive risk-based validation and testing, including test review, issue resolution, business readiness and training needs in accordance with GxP and pharmacovigilance requirements.- For releases and enhancements, you will ensure business readiness and reliable operation, proactively managing risks, dependencies and operational issues while driving continuous improvement.- With a focus on innovation, you will evaluate and shape the responsible adoption of emerging technologies, including AI, to improve efficiency, quality and user experience while maintaining regulatory compliance.- Across functions and organizational boundaries, you will lead initiatives and strategic vendor engagements, provide functional guidance at the intersection of pharmacovigilance and technology, and represent your area in strategic discussions and regulatory inspections.Requirements- Master's degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent professional qualifications and relevant experience- Several years of relevant professional experience in the pharmaceutical industry, a regulatory authority or academia, combined with strong subject-matter expertise- Strong experience with cloud-based enterprise systems, process mapping, data flows and computer-system lifecycle processes, ideally within regulated or GxP environments- Broad knowledge of Good Pharmacovigilance Practice, Patient Safety processes and international pharmacovigilance regulations and guidelines- Sound knowledge of Scrum and agile ways of working, combined with project and change management experience and an understanding of database concepts and emerging technologies such as AI- Strong ownership, decision-making and problem-solving skills,
